Contributing to pruebapaquetes

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for investing your time in contributing to our project! Any contribution you make will help improve this package.

Code of Conduct

By participating in this project, you agree to abide by our Code of Conduct. Please read it before contributing.

How Can I Contribute?

Reporting Bugs

Before creating a bug report, please check the existing Issues list to see if the problem has already been reported. If it hasn’t, open a new issue and include: * A clear and descriptive title. * Steps to reproduce the behavior. * A minimal reproducible example (reprex) using the reprex package if possible. * Your R session information (sessionInfo()).

Suggesting Enhancements

We welcome ideas for new features or improvements. To suggest an enhancement, please open an issue and: * Explain the behavior or feature you would like to see. * Provide examples of how it would be useful or how the syntax would look.

Submitting Pull Requests

  1. Fork the repository and create your branch from main.
  2. If you’ve added code that should be tested, add tests in the tests/testthat directory.
  3. Ensure that the package passes all checks by running devtools::check().
  4. Update the documentation if necessary using devtools::document().
  5. Submit a pull request with a clear description of your changes.

Style Guide

Please follow the tidyverse style guide (styler package can help format your code automatically) for any R code contributions.
